comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
Translates to Inhambane. This is a new East African port that will be added in Chapter 2 of Order of the Prince, located between Natal and Sofala.

Trade goods for sale:
Barley
Sugar Cane
Wetland Rice
African Wood Carving*
Coffee
Cotton
Silver
Rooibos*
Coral
Emerald*†

*Will require investment to appear in market
†Needs a certain development level before it will appear in market
